question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Elated
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Extremely happy and excited".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Elated"** means being extremely happy and excited, often due to success or good news. (बेहद खुश और उत्साहित)

 
 
• **Example:** She felt elated after receiving a promotion at work.
 
 
 
• **Correct word:** "Elated" refers to a heightened state of joy or euphoria. (बेहद खुश)
 
 
• **Example:** He was elated to finally achieve his dream of completing the marathon.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "Extremely happy and excited".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Indifferent or uninterested** (उदासीन या अनिच्छुक): Showing no interest or concern.

 
 
• **Example:** He seemed indifferent to the outcome of the game.
 
 
 
• **Feeling tired and drained** (थका हुआ और ऊर्जा विहीन): Experiencing fatigue or exhaustion.
 
 
• **Example:** After working all day, she felt completely drained.
 
 
 
• **Deeply worried and anxious** (गंभीर रूप से चिंतित और बेचैन): Feeling nervous or uneasy about something.
 
 
• **Example:** He was deeply worried about the safety of his family during the storm.
